Comme dit un proverbe yiddish : Badarf men hunik ven tsuker iz zis? Qui a besoin de miel quand le sucre est doux ?
Any commonly used turn of phrase expressing a metaphor, simile, or descriptive epithet. [before 18th c.]
A striking or paradoxical assertion; an obscure saying; an enigma; a parable.
To give what is needed or desired, especially basic needs.
This resort provides an evening meal for its guests.
Cette station propose un repas du soir à ses clients.
To furnish (with), cause to be present, supply.
The hotel provides towels and a hairdryer.
L’hôtel fournit des serviettes et un sèche-cheveux.
To make a living; earn money for necessities.
It is difficult to provide for my family working on minimum wage.
Il est difficile de subvenir aux besoins de ma famille avec le salaire minimum.
To establish as a previous condition; to stipulate.
The contract provides that the work be well done.
Le contrat stipule que le travail doit être bien fait.
Only if (the stipulation that follows is true).
You can go to the party provided you finish all your homework first.
Tu peux aller à la fête à condition d’avoir fini tous tes devoirs avant.
